title: SeparateGeometryNode — filter geometry by boolean selection
description: Implement a separate_geometry DSL node equivalent to Blender's GeometryNodeSeparateGeometry. Splits input geometry into two outputs based on a boolean selection field: 'selected' (vertices/faces where selection=true) and 'inverted' (where selection=false). This is essential for working on subsets of geometry — selecting top faces for extrusion, isolating boundary edges, splitting meshes by material region, etc. Currently delete_geometry exists but only removes selected elements; separate_geometry preserves both halves.
definition-of-done:
1. New SeparateGeometryNode class in ixdar-app/src/main/java/ixdar/geometry/mesh/nodes/geometry/ with @MeshNodeAnnotation id 'separate_geometry'
2. Input ports: geometry (MeshValue), selection (BooleanField — per-vertex or per-face)
3. Output ports: selected (MeshValue — geometry where selection=true), inverted (MeshValue — geometry where selection=false)
4. Domain mode: VERTEX (split by vertex selection) or FACE (split by face selection)
5. Both outputs are valid standalone meshes (no dangling edges/faces)
6. Registered in MeshNodeRegistry and usable in .dsl files
testing-plan:
1. Unit test: separate cube by top-face selection — verify two valid meshes with correct face counts
2. Unit test: separate by vertex Y > 0 — verify split at equator
3. Unit test: both outputs combined should equal original vertex/face count
4. DSL integration: separate_geometry in a .dsl file, validate with ValidateDsl
5. Mesh probe: verify both output meshes have sensible bounding boxes
